title: A key that would span two lines is reported at the space after its colon
notes: A plain scalar may continue on a more indented line, so "a: b\n c" is the start of the value "b c", and "c:" can still become "c:d", a valid scalar. The colon at 2:3 therefore belongs to a valid document. The space after it (2:4) is the first character that cannot: a key must stay on one line. Positions are 1-based lines and columns counted in characters of the decoded text; the position of an error is the first character that cannot belong to any valid document (docs/case-format.md).
